definition: ἐξ-αιρέω -ῶ  [in LXX chiefly for נָצַל hi. ;] to take out: with accusative, ὀφθαλμόν, Mat.5:29 18:9; mid.  __(a) to take out for oneself, choose: Act.26:17 (Thayer, see word; Page, Ac., l.with, but see infr.);  __(b) to deliver: Act.7:10, 34" (LXX) Act.12:11 Act.23:27 Act.26:17 (EV, but see supr.), Gal.1:4.† (AS)
